howto.name: Upload an image
howto.text: JPG, PNG, WebP up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Set target dimensions and mode
howto.text: Resize: scale to fit (preserves aspect ratio with padding) or fill (crops to fill). Crop: cut to exact dimensions from the center.

howto.name: Download the result
howto.text: Single processed image at the specified dimensions.

faq.a: Resize when you want to keep the entire image. Crop when you have a specific aspect ratio target (e.g. social media banner).
Some sharpness loss is unavoidable when upscaling. For 2x or 4x enlargement with AI smoothing, use Image Upscaler.

faq.q: Can I pick the crop position?
faq.a: Currently crop is centered. Drag-to-crop with a custom anchor is on the roadmap.
